scripts.test:cli: bun run build:cli && bun test packages/cli/test
scripts.test:workers: vitest run --config packages/worker/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/delivery/vitest.config.ts
scripts.types:worker: wrangler types packages/worker/worker-configuration.d.ts -c packages/worker/wrangler.jsonc -c packages/delivery/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler types packages/delivery/worker-configuration.d.ts -c packages/delivery/wrangler.jsonc -c packages/worker/wrangler.jsonc --include-runtime false --env-interface DeliveryEnv
scripts.typecheck: bun run types:worker && tsc --noEmit && bun run types:packages
scripts.types:packages: tsc -p packages/domain/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/worker/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/delivery/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify:bundles: wrangler deploy --dry-run -c packages/worker/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c packages/delivery/wrangler.jsonc
